about: Files moved here byte for byte from bitfield-packages (packages/package-dependencies): each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. The first commit that holds them is the byte copy; later commits change import paths only. A file named .held is the same bytes with its test name taken off so the repository test does not run it; the reason is under `held`. `not_carried` names package files that were left in the package and why.

held.tools/package-dependencies/tests/owner-a: imports react or shared ui parts (@/packages/ui) that live in apps parts/ui, not in the Workshop
held.tools/package-dependencies/tests/process: reads the package boundary file things-to-store-and-run.json (or the package's own data path), which is not carried
held.tools/package-dependencies/tests/relatio: reads the package boundary file things-to-store-and-run.json (or the package's own data path), which is not carried

not_carried.packages/package-dependencies/data/READM: package README, package.json or ignore file; this folder has its own README
not_carried.packages/package-dependencies/do-work/RE: package README, package.json or ignore file; this folder has its own README
not_carried.packages/package-dependencies/entry-to-p: maps package entries to the retired package runtime's entry scope; not carried
not_carried.packages/package-dependencies/processes/: package README, package.json or ignore file; this folder has its own README
not_carried.packages/package-dependencies/proof/READ: proof evidence of the package (screenshots, proof scripts and notes); not carried

not_carried.packages/package-dependencies/read-data/: package README, package.json or ignore file; this folder has its own README
